stem: Which statement describes a direct result of these actions?

options.label: A
options.text: Congress passed a law allowing farmers to charter railroad companies.

options.label: B
options.text: Congress passed the Sherman Antitrust Act to encourage competition among railroad companies.

options.label: C
options.text: Congress passed the Interstate Commerce Act to regulate railroad prices.

options.label: D
options.text: Congress passed a law allowing railroads to sue farmers for exposing railroad prices.

visual_elements:
Box containing excerpt: 'Small businesses and farmers were protesting that the railroads charged them higher rates than larger corporations, and that the railroads were also setting higher rates for short hauls than for long-distance hauls. . . .

. . . When Congress failed to act, some states adopted their own railroad regulations. . . . Continued public anger over unfair railroad rates prompted Illinois senator Shelby M. Cullom to hold [congressional] hearings.

—United States Senate, Senate Historical Office'
